$comment: Rules the ESLint layers enforce at error that the oxlint layers do not.
`oxlint-parity.mjs` fails on any rule missing from oxlint that is absent here,
so every drop is a deliberate, reviewed entry. Measured against oxlint 1.78.0.
`layer` is the ESLint layer the rule is at error in. `native` names the oxlint
rule id when one exists but we still do not enable it. `replacement` records
the intended migration path for each gap.

no-octal.reason: No oxlint rule. Largely covered incidentally: the oxc parser rejects legacy `0`-prefixed octal literals in strict-mode and module code, which is all of our source.
no-octal.replacement: No action unless non-module source becomes supported.

typescript/prefer-optional-chain.reason: Native but `nursery`, and it diverges. It reports `typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID` in @n8n/crdt where ESLint does not, and its fix is wrong: `crypto?.randomUUID` still throws a ReferenceError when the global is undeclared, which is what the typeof guard prevents.
typescript/prefer-optional-chain.impact: Re-evaluate when the rule leaves nursery.
typescript/prefer-optional-chain.replacement: Re-evaluate after the rule leaves nursery and its undeclared-global fix is corrected.

import/export.reason: Native but `nursery`. Not enabling a pre-release rule silently; no divergence observed yet.
import/export.impact: Re-evaluate when the rule leaves nursery.
import/export.replacement: Enable after the rule leaves nursery and parity remains clean.

typescript/consistent-type-imports.reason: oxlint's rule has no `emitDecoratorMetadata` carve-out. typescript-eslint goes silent in any file containing a decorator when `experimentalDecorators` + `emitDecoratorMetadata` are set, because converting such an import to `import type` erases the `design:paramtypes` metadata that DI resolves. oxlint reads no compiler options in this rule and offers no option to declare them, so it reported 3488 false positives across packages/cli/src, all in decorated files. Its fixer also fights n8n-local-rules/no-type-only-import-in-di: one adds `type`, the other removes it, so `oxlint --fix` does not converge.
typescript/consistent-type-imports.impact: Low at runtime. The direction that breaks DI stays guarded by no-type-only-import-in-di, and these packages leave `verbatimModuleSyntax` off, so TypeScript elides a type-only-used import at emit. The cost is drift from a clean baseline.
typescript/consistent-type-imports.replacement: Wait for the upstream emitDecoratorMetadata option, or use an approved shim that suppresses decorated files.

frontend/no-restricted-syntax.reason: editor-ui uses package-specific AST selectors for workflow-store and modal-migration ratchets. The frontend keeps ESLint for these selectors.
frontend/no-restricted-syntax.replacement: Replace each selector with a focused rule before an Oxlint-only frontend migration.

frontend/vue-template-rules.reason: Oxlint extracts a Vue SFC script block but does not expose a template AST.
frontend/vue-template-rules.impact: An Oxlint-only frontend package would lose template and SFC-structure checks.
frontend/vue-template-rules.replacement: Keep eslint-plugin-vue for .vue files, or replace these rules with a template-aware native linter.

n8n-nodes-base/*.reason: The node and credential format rules come from eslint-plugin-n8n-nodes-base. They need a JS-plugin compatibility probe before they can be moved into the shared Oxlint layer.
n8n-nodes-base/*.impact: An Oxlint-only nodes package would lose 82 node and 12 credential format checks.
n8n-nodes-base/*.replacement: Verify the plugin through Oxlint's JS-plugin bridge, then translate its file-scoped rule tables.

@n8n/design-system/require-teleported-to.reason: The rule uses vue-eslint-parser's defineTemplateBodyVisitor. Oxlint does not expose Vue template parser services to JS plugins.
@n8n/design-system/require-teleported-to.impact: An Oxlint-only frontend package would lose the dropdown tooltip teleportation guard.
@n8n/design-system/require-teleported-to.replacement: Keep this ESLint rule for Vue files, or add a native template-aware Oxlint rule.
